recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Future changes to entryMode definitions, codes, examples, or behavior guidance should be made in HL7/sdc; core should continue to rely on its existing SDC references for advanced question-flow behavior.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking for an extension to control questionnaire flow: current question only, current and prior questions, or all questions in arbitrary order.
initial_application: The Jira comment references Git#d47cc1b, but that short SHA is not present in current HL7/fhir history or GitHub for HL7/fhir. The matching artifact is visible in the May 2019 SDC publication as `sdc-questionnaire-entryMode`, with the same sequential, prior-edit, and random flow semantics.
additional_context: Current FHIR core has Questionnaire active in `source/fhir.ini` and its Questionnaire notes explicitly direct advanced rendering, question flow, data management, and adaptive questionnaire behavior to the SDC implementation guide. Current HL7/sdc source owns `sdc-questionnaire-entryMode`, the EntryMode code system/value set, and later FHIR-37497 refinements. Core source and the FHIR Extension Pack do not own this SDC-canonical extension.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was edited because duplicating the SDC extension or adding redundant core prose would conflict with current source ownership.

related_jiras.note: SDC later revised entryMode code definitions and usage notes for validation/paging behavior, confirming ongoing maintenance belongs in the SDC IG.
A different Questionnaire extension issue about `questionnaire-usageMode` modifier status surfaced during search but concerns capture/display usage, not the flow-control entryMode extension.
